$comment: Project-scoped MCP server config. Claude Code reads this automatically when you open
this folder, so the CareerLens job-market tools become available in your session.
Requires the stack to be running:  cd infra && docker compose up -d
This exposes ONLY aggregate job-market data. No email, resume, applications or user
accounts — see services/mcp-server/app/main.py for why that boundary is enforced by
network isolation rather than by convention.
